shortDescription: NetApp Element Software Check connectivity to MVIP and SVIP.

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the SolidFire cluster. For na_elementsw_cluster, the Management IP (MIP) or hostname of the node to initiate the cluster creation from.

options.name: mvip
options.description: Optionally, use to test connection of a different MVIP. This is not needed to test the connection to the target cluster.

options.name: skip
options.description: Skip checking connection to SVIP or MVIP.

options.name: svip
options.description: Optionally, use to test connection of a different SVIP. This is not needed to test the connection to the target cluster.

options.name: username
options.description: Please ensure that the user has the adequate permissions. For more information, please read the official documentation U(https://mysupport.netapp.com/documentation/docweb/index.html?productID=62636&language=en-US).
